own: There is reason for a vendor to be able to set multiple bands. For 200 to 1,000, I might want people that have done 1,000 trades. I think there is justification for having multiple bands of currency, but there has to be a reason why. There needs to be something else that goes with it to justify having that additional band. I don't know if we need to talk about this more or what.
question: Should a vendor be able to set more than one amount band per currency now?
